modifications: Establish a standalone read-only API and CLI for selecting one adjustment view by canonical Alpaca asset UUID.
Return unchanged authenticated frozen bars at UUID boundaries together with recorded integrity failures and applicable warning-overlay findings.
Authenticate validation, correlation, warning, and frozen-download boundaries without updating or repairing any artifact.
Select histories by the repository's deterministic internal security ID rather than by one Alpaca asset UUID.
Return all contributing Alpaca IDs, CUSIPs, ticker history, and exact segment-level vendor provenance beneath the internal historical-pricing identity.
Ignore correlation generations from earlier schema versions during repository-wide discovery because they cannot contain an internal security ID from this reader contract.
Resolve reads exclusively through the authenticated global security-master index instead of scanning ticker correlation manifests.
Accept the repository master ID through --master-id and reject Alpaca UUIDs or unpublished digest values.
Return the clean master identity metadata and exact master-index digest provenance while keeping errors and warnings in their separate read-result sections.
Read provider-neutral online status directly from each authenticated per-master-ID identity shard without recalculating its dependencies for every consumer.
Expose public APIs to query one master ID's persisted online boolean and list the identities whose pipeline-published status is true.
Return the stored online boolean with a history while keeping Alpaca active/inactive metadata independent from repository availability.
Return each published master ID's persisted availability_status classification alongside its online boolean.
Expose a read-only status-filtered listing API so unresolved lineage_gap identities can be queried without rescanning bar histories.
Keep lineage-gap histories readable for investigation while excluding them from the online inventory.
Resolve differing adjusted duplicate bars only when one authenticated source has a strict superset of the other source's correlated session coverage.
Keep every raw disagreement plus equal-coverage and partial-overlap adjusted disagreements as hard read errors instead of preferring an ambiguous source.
Return an aggregated source_selection audit showing every differing overlap resolved by the strict-superset rule.
Resolve an otherwise-unresolved authenticated bar disagreement only when exactly one contributing source was requested under the dated historical ticker assigned to that row.
Apply historical-ticker selection after the existing equal-value and adjusted strict-superset rules so previously readable histories retain their selected values.
Keep disagreements with zero or multiple ticker-matching sources as hard read errors and report the applied selection rule in source-selection provenance.
